reviews.text: I have had very good experiences with veterinarian Jolijn. She takes her time and puts the veterinarians at ease. Very good results with my cat (due to stress and resulting urethral obstruction). I have now also been with my Labrador, who is currently on a diet.
A really nice place where they think along with you. They look at the whole picture. We love coming here!

Very good practice.

Our little dog was registered at Evedensia; she was 7 months old.

We visited Caspar and Stephanie several times.
She is now a healthy, happy 4-year-old dog.
Jolein takes plenty of time for your pet and treats the animal with respect. Casper has also had good experiences with her.
Really take the time for your dog. And don't immediately load him with medication.
The best place in Amsterdam to take your pet
Caspar is such a wonderful veterinarian; he thinks in the best interest of the animal and not, like the big chains, about the money.

We look back with great satisfaction on our visit to Jolijn with our 20-year-old cat, Dièm. Jolijn took ample time and provided well-founded advice. Even after our visit, she provided detailed additional advice via email, which has been very helpful to us.
A very pleasant clinic with a wealth of knowledge that goes far beyond what a regular veterinarian can offer. They look for the root cause of problems and don't just treat symptoms.

Wonderful!
What lovely people!
So knowledgeable, and I have a healthy cat again ♥️
Attention for your pet without empty promises, everything in its purest form. Fantastic service.
We recently had our first visit. Annette saw both our dogs. The interaction with her was nice. Waiting now to see the effects of the medicines.
Received very expert and friendly help from Annette. Miniature Dachshund with a hernia... recovered very quickly!
Caspar is one of a kind, I recommend his practice with full trust and confidence!
A nice veterinary practice where they take plenty of time for your animal.
